title: REQ · Pure helper trackedNodeModulesPaths filters paths containing a node_modules segment
summary: Helper returns only node_modules paths from a file list.
description: Context: no helper exists in game/frontend/src/lib. Desired: export trackedNodeModulesPaths(paths: string[]): string[] that keeps paths with a 'node_modules' path segment. Why: basis for cleanup and guard.
acceptance_criteria: Given ['a/node_modules/x.js','src/a.ts'], when filtered, then only the first path is returned.
Given 'src/my_node_modules_note.ts', when filtered, then it is not returned because it lacks a node_modules segment.
